name: Solana del Pino (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Solana del Pino (a pine between two deer on yellow above green).
history: Municipal flag of Solana del Pino; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Solana del Pino arms — pine between two deer
